name: Vaibhav Tripathi
bio: Hi, I’m Vaibhav from Pune, India. I’m a frontend developer, and I like listening to music.
introduction: I make good frontend for people willing to pay.

experience.summary: Three years of freelance experience, working on premium projects for a range of clients.

projects.name: Personal Computer
projects.description: A playful 3D desk that opens into an interactive portfolio desktop.
projects.problem: Make an expressive portfolio easy to navigate, credible, and simple to update.
projects.contribution: I directed the portfolio’s creative direction and content, collaborating with an AI coding assistant on implementation.
projects.approach: A procedural Three.js computer, a scroll-driven journey through its screen, keyboard-accessible desktop apps, project dialogs, and a public Quality Lab. Content lives in one JSON file.
projects.outcome: A working local portfolio and an editable Quality Lab. Browser-test evidence is documented in the project’s quality report; publication and peer review are separate steps.
